name: Thriving Bluff
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than red.
{T}: Add {R} or one mana of the chosen color.
blocked_sentences: As it enters, choose a color other than red.
{T}: Add {R} or one mana of the chosen color.

needs.what: a `choose_color` that excludes printed colours from the offer -- e.g. `{"op": "choose_color", "except_colors": ["R"]}` for "choose a color other than red" -- so the chooser is offered only the four remaining colours and `chosen_color` can never be the excluded one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_color` (op_options: only `prompt`; `op_choose_color` in engine/effects/ops_control.py) always offers all five COLOR_CHOICES, so the land could choose red and then tap for only {R}, which is a different card from the printed one

needs.what: a mana ability offering a fixed symbol OR the permanent's chosen colour -- "{T}: Add {R} or one mana of the chosen color" -- i.e. a `choose_mode` whose modes are `add_mana {R}` and `add_mana {"chosen_color_of": "self"}`, with the solver's options being {R} plus the source's live `chosen_color`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader's chosen-colour mana branch (`mana_chosen_color` in cards/loader/__init__.py) requires the ability be a single `add_mana` with `{"chosen_color_of": "self"}` and refuses a second effect; a `choose_mode` over five literal colours (the starting_point) taps for any colour, strictly better than the printed card
